principle.name: Accessibility First
principle.description: Ensure all website components are accessible to users with disabilities.
principle.rationale: Accessibility is a legal and ethical requirement; it also improves usability for all users.

example.scenario: Adding a new button to a page
example.good: Include proper ARIA labels, sufficient color contrast, and keyboard navigation support.
example.bad: Using low-contrast text or relying solely on mouse hover events.

principle.name: Performance Optimization
principle.description: Optimize website assets and code for fast loading and smooth interaction.
principle.rationale: Performance directly impacts user experience, SEO, and conversion rates.

example.good: Compress images, use modern formats (WebP), and implement lazy loading.
example.bad: Uploading large, uncompressed PNG files without optimization.

principle.name: Brand Consistency
principle.description: Maintain visual and tonal consistency with the Sounio brand guidelines.
principle.rationale: Consistent branding builds trust and recognition across all touchpoints.

example.good: Use the official color palette, typography, and logo placement as defined in Brand/.
example.bad: Introducing arbitrary colors or fonts that deviate from the brand.

principle.name: Responsive Design
principle.description: Ensure the website works well on all screen sizes and devices.
principle.rationale: Users access the site from a variety of devices; responsive design ensures usability for everyone.

example.good: Use CSS media queries to adapt layout for mobile, tablet, and desktop.
example.bad: Fixed-width layouts that break on smaller screens.

convention.rule: Follow BEM naming convention for CSS classes
Use modern ES6+ syntax and avoid global variables

pitfall.description: Overloading a single CSS file with unrelated styles
pitfall.why_problematic: Makes maintenance difficult and increases bundle size.
pitfall.correct_approach: Split styles into modular files (e.g., components/, layouts/) and use Hugo's asset pipeline.

pitfall.why_problematic: Some features may not work in older browsers, excluding users.
pitfall.correct_approach: Test in major browsers (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge) and use progressive enhancement.

pitfall.description: Forgetting to update Hugo config when adding new content types
pitfall.why_problematic: New pages may not render correctly or appear in navigation.
pitfall.correct_approach: Review config.toml and ensure front matter matches Hugo's expectations.

category.name: before_starting
category.item: Review the Sounio brand guidelines (Brand/ directory)
Check existing Hugo layouts for patterns to reuse
Understand the target audience and user needs

category.name: during_implementation
category.item: Write semantic HTML with proper accessibility attributes
Optimize images and other static assets
Validate CSS and JavaScript for errors

category.name: before_completion
category.item: Check accessibility with axe or similar tool
